summary: Consolidated candidate https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2780 at exact commit 333b37951dfca5d98dffb77b25ee5a8e0801100b and corrected the architecture-independent admission defects reproduced by review https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2868. Level 1 now rejects nonzero explicit temperature even with top_k=1, beam search, and any target or assistant repository/revision other than the two immutable pins. The candidate's other implementation remains intact. Apple Silicon/MLX runtime claims remain unverified on this Linux/ROCm host.

tests.command: direct Python admission probes against exact candidate commit 333b37951dfca5d98dffb77b25ee5a8e0801100b
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced successful admission for temperature=0.7 with top_k=1, beam_width=2, and arbitrary shape-compatible model/revision identities. Evidence: reports/j-861cd6d3373a/raw/failing-before.txt
5 tests and 27 subtests passed, including the six failing-before adversarial admission cases. Evidence: reports/j-861cd6d3373a/raw/passing-after.txt
38 passed, 11 MLX-gated skipped, and 32 subtests passed; preserves the candidate's architecture-independent Stage A coverage.
76 tests and 17 subtests passed, including Python/Rust positional SamplingParams schema lockstep.
The pinned Stage B test collected and skipped because Darwin arm64, MLX, and mlx-vlm are unavailable. Evidence: reports/j-861cd6d3373a/raw/platform-and-stage-b.txt

tests.what_was_measured: Changed Python sources compile and the complete consolidated diff has no whitespace errors.
Rust tests could not run because cargo is absent from the prepared environment; the Python schema lockstep test passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The available accelerator is AMD Instinct MI355X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 on Linux x86_64. mlx and mlx_vlm are unavailable, and ROCm execution cannot qualify an Apple Silicon MLX feature.

remaining_limitations: No Apple Silicon/Darwin arm64 host was available, so real target-only versus MTP numerical parity was not executed.
The pinned target and assistant weights were not downloaded or executed; MLX native-cache behavior, proposal and verification counters, cleanup, cache flush, and post-flush serving remain unverified.
Eleven MLX-dependent Stage A cases and the pinned Stage B test skip on this host.
Cargo is absent from the prepared environment, so the changed Rust SamplingParams mirror could not be compiled locally; Python's Rust-schema lockstep regression passed.
No C++, FlyDSL, or native MLX source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The source issue's concurrency, heterogeneous paged/radix KV, and performance/overlap follow-up tracks remain out of scope.
